# PART 5 — WORLD GEOGRAPHY

**UPPCS Priority: 🔴 VERY HIGH**

**Prelims importance: ~9/10**

This part is a **pure World Geography Ratta section**: continents, mountains, peaks, rivers, lakes, deserts, plateaus, grasslands, islands, seas, gulfs, bays, straits, canals, resources and climatic regions.

I'm deliberately focusing on **location → feature → country/region** associations rather than descriptive geography.

---

# 1. 🌍 CONTINENTS — BASIC RATTA

| Fact                  | Answer        |
| --------------------- | ------------- |
| Largest continent     | **Asia**      |
| Smallest continent    | **Australia** |
| Largest by population | **Asia**      |
| Largest by area       | **Asia**      |
| Second largest        | Africa        |
| Third largest         | North America |
| Fourth largest        | South America |
| Fifth largest         | Antarctica    |
| Sixth largest         | Europe        |
| Seventh smallest/last | Australia     |

### 🔴 Order by area

> **Asia → Africa → North America → South America → Antarctica → Europe → Australia**
